# Contributing

Bug reports, themes and fixes are welcome.

## Layout

| Path | What |
| --- | --- |
| `.claude-plugin/plugin.json` | manifest and every user option (`userConfig`) |
| `hooks/register.tsx` | the render hook and everything that touches `$` |
| `hooks/markdown.ts` | markdown to blocks and inline nodes, pure and tested |
| `hooks/render.tsx` | blocks to `Box`/`Text` trees |
| `hooks/theme.ts` | presets, color validation, option merging |
| `hooks/mermaid.tsx` | mermaid box art, pure |
| `hooks/vendor/` | generated by `npm --prefix scripts run build:vendor`, never edited by hand |
| `tests/` | `claude plugin test` suites |

## Rules

- No new runtime dependencies. The bundled libraries are beautiful-mermaid and Prism (both MIT); anything else bundled must be MIT and listed in docs/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md.
- No code comments. Put the why in the PR description.
- `$` can't cross an import: code that calls `$` lives in `hooks/register.tsx`, everything else stays pure.
- Every new option goes in `plugin.json` `userConfig` and the README table.
- Anything visual gets a test that mounts `AssistantMessage` on `terminal` and `desktop`, plus a screenshot in the PR.
- New built-in themes need a screenshot on both a dark and a light terminal.

## CI

Every push and PR runs: tests on Linux, macOS and Windows, a type-check, a byte-for-byte rebuild of `hooks/vendor`, version agreement, a no-comments check and a clean install. Tags `vX.Y.Z` publish a release.

## Loop

```
claude --plugin-dir .
claude plugin validate .
claude plugin test .
```

Running `claude --plugin-dir .` once lays the API types into `.claude-plugin/types/`, so `tsc -p .` type-checks the repo.
